messages.subject: Lena | Global Mining Executive Profile | Government Relations, ESG & Country Leadership
messages.body:
Dear Ms. Kozovski,

I am sharing my profile for senior international mining and natural-resources leadership mandates.

I serve as Liaison Director, Social Responsibility Department at AGM Inc., part of Zijin Mining Group. My portfolio spans government and regulatory relations, ESG and social performance, corporate and external affairs, stakeholder strategy, strategic partnerships, compliance coordination and executive communications for a major gold-mining operation.

My current exposure also includes a large renewable-energy platform supporting mining operations, with approximately 46-50 MWp of solar and more than 80 MWh of battery storage.

As Amrop's Global Practice Leader for Mining, your work across senior strategic hiring, board and C-suite recruitment and sustainability-related leadership makes my profile directly relevant to the mandates your practice handles. My strongest value sits where a mining business needs a senior leader who can connect operations with government, regulators, communities and responsible-growth priorities.

I am targeting Director, Senior Director, Head, Country Director and VP-track mandates across External Affairs, Government Relations, Corporate Affairs, ESG, Sustainability, Social Performance, Strategic Partnerships and Country Leadership.

I have attached a mining-focused executive CV for confidential consideration. I am internationally mobile and available on 30 days' notice. Saudi Arabia and the UAE are priority GCC markets, while I remain open to strong global mandates.

Kind regards,
Ragunauth Ramsaroop
Liaison Director, Social Responsibility Department | AGM Inc.
